name: get-done-code
description: Set your own coding goals (every 100 lines, a daily GitHub contribution). Hit one and a reward image you chose unlocks. Works in VS Code, Cursor and Antigravity.

commands.title: Get Done: Add Reward Image Link
Get Done: Check GitHub Contribution Now

getDone.rewardImages.markdownDescription: Your own reward image links (https). Shown one at a time, in order, each time a goal is hit.

getDone.criteria.markdownDescription: Goals that unlock a reward. Each item: `{ "type": "lines", "every": 100 }` (lines written), `{ "type": "saves", "every": 10 }` (file saves), `{ "type": "minutes", "every": 30 }` (minutes of active typing), or `{ "type": "github" }` (one reward per day you make a GitHub contribution).

getDone.githubPollMinutes.description: How often to check GitHub for today's contributions (github goal only).
